nameEn: Manufacture of machinery for mining, quarrying and construction
description: This class includes the manufacture of machinery used in mining, quarrying, and construction activities.
includes: manufacture of machinery for the extraction of minerals: boring, sinking or drilling equipment for underground or overground mining
manufacture of coal or rock cutters and tunnelling machines
manufacture of machinery for sorting, screening, separating, washing, crushing, grinding, mixing or kneading earth, stone, ore or other mineral substances
manufacture of concrete and mortar mixers
manufacture of bulldozers, graders, road rollers, scrapers, off-highway dumpers
manufacture of mechanical shovels, excavators and shovel loaders
manufacture of pile drivers and pile extractors
manufacture of concrete pumps, adjustable props, mortar applicators
excludes: manufacture of lifting and handling equipment, see 2816
manufacture of power-driven hand tools, see 2818
manufacture of machinery for treating metals, see 2823
